Original instrumental wuxia suspense cue, sparse wooden ticks and restrained low bowed strings. Space between pulses for breath, cloth strain and heavy stone impacts. Modest forward momentum as two injured porters cooperate; never triumphant or fast action spectacle. No vocals, no trailer risers.
